fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN) recent earnings have been driven by AWS AI infrastructure growth and mark-to-market gains on Anthropic stake, but actual cash earnings are offset by approximately $220 billion in annual large-scale capital expenditures.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS capacity expansion and retail efficiency improvement are core operational priorities, and whether Amazon Leo satellite network and Anthropic cloud commitments can convert into future high-margin cash earnings is the key investment focus.
